entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 211 aa soluble, acidic protein; calculated molecular mass 23.3 kDa and pI 4.82.
Contains a high-confidence Ham1p_like domain (Pfam PF01725.22) spanning residues 19–205.
Shows 56.9% identity over 90.5% query coverage to reviewed Rhizobium meliloti dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase Q92SK4.
Likely catalyzes Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates, especially dITP, ITP, and XTP, to the corresponding monophosphates plus diphosphate.
Likely functions as a nucleotide-pool sanitization enzyme that prevents incorporation of damaged or noncanonical purines into nucleic acids.
Exact substrate preference and oligomeric state are inferred from homologs and are not experimentally established for this query sequence.

entities.name: Q92SK4
observations: Reviewed Rhizobium meliloti dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; EC 3.6.1.66.
Hydrolyzes XTP, dITP, and ITP to monophosphate products and diphosphate.
Binds one Mg2+ per subunit and is annotated as a homodimer.
Annotated to cytosol and purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolic process.

entities.name: Purine nucleotide pool sanitization
observations: Biological process inferred for the query protein from conserved Ham1p-like homology and curated homolog annotations.
Removes noncanonical purine triphosphates from the nucleotide pool, reducing potential incorporation into DNA or RNA.
